summary.text: Jared Storm is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 23, serving since 2024. His committee assignments are Agriculture, General Affairs, and Judiciary.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Storm was born March 27, 1971, in Scott City, Kansas, and graduated from Scott Community High School in 1989.
He earned a B.S. from Kansas State University in 1994.
His biography lists his occupation as small business owner and entrepreneur, with past work as a middle school teacher, and honors including the 2018 Nebraska Airman of the Year.
It lists him as married to Colleen, with six children.
